name: Adrian Popescu
bio:
Adrian's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While many dream of the racetrack, Adrian found his calling in the intricate world of metalwork. After graduating from a technical college in Bucharest, he honed his skills in a local machine shop, mastering the art of precision engineering. A chance encounter with a former racing engineer sparked his interest in motorsport, leading him to apply his expertise to race car components. 

Adrian joined Proton by Premotion five years ago, quickly becoming a key member of the machining team. His pragmatic approach and unwavering focus on quality make him invaluable when fabricating critical components. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to troubleshoot complex manufacturing challenges, ensuring that every part meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. Adrian's commitment to excellence, coupled with his deep understanding of materials science, sets him apart as a master machinist.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky man with strong hands and a focused gaze, reflecting years of precision work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Insists on listening to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and handwritten notes, which he consults religiously.
